topicA: AI Visibility and Answer Engine Optimization for B2B Brands

recap.intro: This week you explored two areas of B2B marketing that are rapidly changing: how AI impacts your brand's visibility and how to strategically organize your revenue and go-to-market efforts.
bullets: Even though AI tools like ChatGPT are popular, Google's AI-powered search still drives nearly all B2B sales and conversions.
It's vital to ensure your brand's content is visible to AI assistants, as many tech buyers now use them to discover new companies.
Strategic adjustments to online ads and website testing can significantly boost qualified leads and revenue for B2B businesses.
While AI isn't causing widespread job losses, it is quietly reducing entry-level opportunities, which could impact future talent pipelines.
recap.closing: This week you learned that staying competitive in B2B marketing means understanding both the evolving role of AI in customer discovery and the strategic orchestration of your entire revenue generation process.
